data.one_liner: An animated search bar widget with multiple customization options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a search bar widget that expands and collapses with an animation. It supports text controllers, right-to-left layout, auto-focus, custom icons, and suffix tap handlers.
use_when: You need an expandable search bar in your app's UI
You want custom animations and styling for search inputs
avoid_when: You need a static or permanently expanded search bar
You require complex search logic built directly into the widget
strengths: Easy to customize with icons, colors, and widths
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic parameter lists
Requires manual state management via TextEditingController
